name: muse
description: A modern music player built with Electron

scripts.dev: pnpm run electron:install && concurrently -k "pnpm run dev:renderer" "pnpm run dev:electron:build" "pnpm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 dist-electron/main.cjs dist-electron/preload.cjs && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 pnpm exec electronmon .
scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:assets && pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:electron
scripts.package: pnpm run electron:install && pnpm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
